acceptance: Read docs/04/supervisor_dispatch_refactor_proposal_2026-08-04.md section 'Problem 3' for full context, including the confirmed live repro (ActivityAuditInvariantError: 'activity content-addressed archives do not match lineage', transient, tied to a concurrency burst right after a supervisor restart, which silently dropped a worker's status write-back with zero trace on the task record).

Do not weaken _validate_active_lineage_head_unlocked or any other fail-closed integrity check itself -- the guarantee is real and intentional (see the original PR #4221 incident this protects against).

Extend the existing outbox concept (STATUS_ARCHIVE_OUTBOX_KEY / STATUS_ACTIVITY_OUTBOX_KEY) so that a status write which cannot clear the integrity check is durably queued for retry AND marks the task itself (e.g. status_write_pending: true plus a pending count), rather than leaving the task record byte-identical to its pre-attempt state.

A human or auto-worker reading the board must be able to distinguish 'this task's displayed state may be stale, N writes queued behind an integrity block' from 'this task genuinely has not been touched.'

This touches the exact mechanism responsible for a prior 4-hour production outage (see SUPERVISOR_REWRITE_PLAN.md motivation). Shadow-verify behavior-equivalence against the incumbent per rewrite/shadow.py discipline before any cutover; ship behind a flag.
Land only after SUP-PROVIDER-PROBE-HYSTERESIS-20260804 and SUP-TASK-FAILURE-STREAK-SCHEMA-20260804 are merged, per the risk-based sequencing in the proposal doc.

Reviewer Claude: reopen at dc06bbdae. Reproduced 187 passed (pytest scripts/test_ai_status.py) but acceptance is not met. (1) Acceptance 5 undelivered: no feature flag anywhere -- _update_pending_outbox_indicators runs unconditionally in commit_state_with_activity_outbox (ai_status.py:2580) on every status transaction, and there is no shadow verification although .orchestrator/rewrite/shadow.py exists. This is the highest-risk of the four fixes; 'ship behind a flag' is explicit. (2) Acceptance 4 undelivered at the board layer: grep shows no reader of status_write_pending outside ai_status.py/test; .orchestrator/common.py (declared artifact) untouched; the new except branch (ai_status.py:2552-2555) calls save_state only, never refresh_derived_status_views, so current-work.md and docs-site mirrors never show it; and 'show' is a read_only command that fails closed with status_recovery_pending (ai_status.py:8130-8135) whenever an outbox is pending -- the governed board read refuses to render during exactly the window the indicator is set. The field is observable only by reading raw ai-status.json. (3) Whole-board false positive: at ai_status.py:2484 'not pending_task_ids' marks EVERY task pending when no queued event carries task_id. Real trigger: wave_open/wave_close/wave_freeze events (ai_status.py:7780/7793/7806) have no task_id. Probe: 3 tasks + 1 task_id-less event -> all 3 got status_write_pending=true, which inverts the acceptance. (4) Count is global, not per-task: probe with 3 events for A and 1 for B gave both status_write_pending_count=4; acceptance asks for N writes queued behind the block for that task. (5) Process: no task PR and origin/task/SUP-STATUS-OUTBOX-INTEGRITY-VISIBILITY-20260804 does not exist, so the committed docs/reviews manifest is not in any PR diff and no exact-head approval can be bound. (6) recover_status_archive_outbox now strips both new fields before the snapshot comparison (ai_status.py:2419-2429) -- acceptable in principle, but nothing strips them at snapshot staging time, so a task archived while a prior write is pending carries them into the immutable archive record. (7) Minor: unused 'as exc' at ai_status.py:2552; stray trailing blank lines at end of scripts/test_ai_status.py; the only new test calls the private helper directly, so no test covers an actual integrity-blocked status write leaving a durable visible indicator; and please explain the two added ai_status.configure_status_root_paths(root) calls in the sigkill test helpers.

Ready for re-review.

Independent re-review of PR #4584 @96ffcd0a fails on three blockers. (1) FAILING TEST: I ran PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator pytest -q scripts/test_ai_status.py -> 187 passed, 1 FAILED (CanonicalTaskStateAndActivityRecoveryTests::test_status_write_pending_indicators, scripts/test_ai_status.py:7962, 'AssertionError: None is not true'); the test never sets PANTHEON_STATUS_OUTBOX_VISIBILITY_ENABLED so the flag defaults off. The commit Verified: trailer and docs/reviews/...-review.md both claim '188 passed' - that claim is false. (2) ACCEPTANCE 4 STILL UNMET - whole-board false positive was NOT prevented: in _update_pending_outbox_indicators (scripts/ai_status.py:2523-2524) any task with specific_count==0 is stamped status_write_pending=true whenever a single unbound event is queued. Unbound events are real, not hypothetical: wave_open/wave_close/wave_freeze (ai_status.py:7817,7830,7843) carry wave_id and no task_id. So one blocked wave write labels EVERY untouched task 'may be stale, 1 write queued', which destroys the exact stale-vs-untouched distinction the task exists to create. Your own new test asserts this defect as intended behaviour (test_status_write_pending_indicators_feature_flag_and_per_task_counting Test 3: TASK-C has no pending write yet is asserted True). Fix: only mark tasks that actually have a queued task-bound write; surface unbound blockage as a board-level indicator, not per-task. (3) CI BLOCKED: 'Commit trailers' fails on both commits - subject exceeds 72 chars (96ffcd0a=89, dc06bbda=83), so PR #4584 is BLOCKED and cannot merge. Follow-up commits cannot fix this (the gate re-scans origin/dev..HEAD); reset + push --force-with-lease on task/ with <=70 char subjects. Also fix in the same pass: (4) .orchestrator/common.py's only change, STATUS_OUTBOX_VISIBILITY_ENABLED_ENV, is dead - ai_status.py:2455 and shadow.py hardcode the literal string. (5) unbound_count (ai_status.py:2508-2513): the 'len(archive_snapshots) if has_pending_archive and not archive_snapshots' branch is provably 0 (len of an empty list), masked by max(1,...). (6) review manifest section 4 claims derived board projections render the pending state - they do not; write_current_work (ai_status.py:3502-3529) emits a fixed ID/Phase/Task/Owner/Status/Depends On/zh column set and no renderer was changed, so refresh_derived_status_views(state) regenerates identical markdown. Either render the indicator or correct the manifest. (7) shadow verification is vacuous: compare_outbox_indicators never compares against the incumbent or sets exit_code; I ran PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator python -m rewrite.shadow --config .orchestrator/config.json --board ai-status.json -> exit 0, 'outbox_indicators shadow: 6 tasks checked, 0 marked pending' against an empty outbox, proving nothing. The manifest's documented command also omits PYTHONPATH and the repo-root cwd, so as written it raises FileNotFoundError. (8) explain the unrelated configure_status_root_paths additions at test_ai_status.py:190,209. Not changed and confirmed fine: fail-closed integrity checks untouched, archive snapshot stripping and both-sides strip in recover_status_archive_outbox are correct, activity outbox durably retained on ActivityAuditInvariantError.
